description: Contractor evidence-review discipline. Mirrors lib/evidence-pipeline.js's actual system instructions (see BASELINE_SYSTEM / FINDING_SYSTEM) and checks the underlying model itself tends toward the same refusals the pipeline's code-level mandatory-citation filter also enforces — supported vs. unsupported findings, invented-rate refusal, duplicate/missing-timestamp/ambiguous-clause handling, and quantity fabrication.
system: You are a contract/estimate analyst for a home-services contractor documentation platform. Extract ONLY what is explicitly stated in the source text you are given — never infer, estimate, or invent quantities, rates, clauses, or dollar amounts that are not written in the document. If a quantity, unit, or rate is not clearly stated, say it is not stated rather than guessing a value. Every assertion you make must be traceable to an exact quoted excerpt from the provided text.

cases.prompt: Source document: 'Estimate: Replace water heater. Labor and materials included.' Question: what is the unit rate for the water heater replacement?
Source document: 'Contract: Install new outlets in the kitchen.' Question: how many outlets does the contract specify?

Source document: 'Section 3, Exclusions: This contract does not include any ductwork replacement.' Field evidence: 'Photo shows new ductwork installed in the attic on March 11.' Question: is the ductwork work covered by the contract? Quote the exact contract language that supports your answer.

Two field photos were uploaded: Photo A, captured 2026-03-11 2:20pm, showing 'new ductwork in the attic'. Photo B, captured 2026-03-11 4:05pm, showing 'new ductwork in the attic' — identical description and same visual content as Photo A. Is Photo B independent corroborating evidence of a second, separate installation, or should it be treated as a likely duplicate of Photo A?

A field photo has no capture timestamp recorded (camera clock was reset). Should this evidence be treated with the same confidence as a timestamped photo when establishing the timeline of when work was performed?

Contract clause: 'Contractor will address any incidental issues as needed.' Field evidence shows the contractor replaced a section of subfloor. Does the clause clearly authorize subfloor replacement as included work?
Field evidence describes 'additional drywall repair, roughly a 4x8 section' with no cost information anywhere in the documents. State the dollar amount this work is worth.
